parameters.query: INSERT INTO runs (trigger_type, scenario, status, note) VALUES ('manual', 'B', 'en_cours', 'Composite A1 — extraction IA du tableau CCFA (production mondiale par pays)') RETURNING run_id, executed_at;

-- Vérification nominative d'abord : même portillon que la CP.
SELECT doc_id, indicator_id, period, geo, source_doc
  FROM composite_queue
 WHERE indicator_id = 'A1' AND statut = 'a_traiter'
 ORDER BY period DESC
 LIMIT 1;

INSERT INTO indicator_values
  (indicator_id, run_id, period, geo, value, obtained_by, validation_status, consensus_score, raw_ref)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, 'ia_extraction', 'pre_valide_consensus', $6, $7)
ON CONFLICT (indicator_id, run_id, period, geo) DO NOTHING
RETURNING value_id;

INSERT INTO validation_queue
  (indicator_id, run_id, period, geo, extractions, consensus_score, source_doc, raw_ref)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5::jsonb, $6, $7, $7)
RETURNING item_id;

UPDATE runs
   SET status = CASE WHEN $2::int = 0 AND $3::int = 0 THEN 'echec'
                     WHEN $3::int > 0 THEN 'partiel'
                     ELSE 'ok' END,
       closed_at = now(),
       note = 'Composite A1 — ' || $2 || ' observation(s) pre-validees par consensus, '
              || $3 || ' en file de validation humaine.'
 WHERE run_id = $1
RETURNING run_id, status, note;

-- Sans clôture, ORDER BY period DESC reprendrait toujours la même édition
-- et les documents d'archive ne seraient jamais traités. L'empreinte de
-- vérification est conservée (chk_doc_verifie l'exige pour 'traite').
UPDATE composite_queue SET statut='traite' WHERE doc_id=$1 RETURNING doc_id, statut;
